integrity: Proof is self-contained; exhaustive labeled graph checks through six vertices provide finite consistency checks only and are not claimed as infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected loopless simple graphs over the real numbers; adjacency nullity exactly one. The higher-nullity case is unresolved here. Literature comparisons cannot exclude unindexed prior equivalent results.
title: Corank-one rigidity for graph and random-walk evolution algebras
